rows.label: Piped town gas service
rows.source_ref: City Energy Handbook on Gas Supply (2021) Appendix B; introduction
rows.source_note: Low-pressure supply 10 to 20 mbar at the service isolation valve (0.02 bar stored here). Supplied to most homes and to commercial kitchens.

sources.locator: Appendix B, Range of low pressure supply
sources.quoted_phrase: Gas supply pressure: Between 10 mbars and 20 mbars
Town gas is retailed island-wide to most residential households.

rows.label: Gas leak detection with fail-safe shut-off
rows.source_ref: SCDF Fire Code 2023 Cl.10.1.5

sources.locator: Cl.10.1.5a and b Gas leak detection system

rows.label: Generator diesel day tank
rows.source_ref: SCDF Fire Code 2023 Cl.3.2.5j; SCDF General Information of P&FM Licences
rows.source_note: Diesel is Class III petroleum in Singapore (flash point above 60 and up to 93 °C); flash_point_c left null because the source gives a band, not a value.

sources.locator: Cl.3.2.5j(1) Areas of special high risk, explanation
sources.quoted_phrase: A max. capacity of 700 litres of diesel oil is permitted to be stored in the generator room.
Class III: Flash point above 60°C but not more than 93°C

rows.label: Bulk diesel storage tank
rows.source_ref: SCDF Fire Code 2023 Cl.3.2.5j; SCDF P&FM licence documents list
rows.source_note: Bulk tanks sit outdoors at ground level; tanks of 30 kL or more above ground trigger a QRA check. Class III band as for day tanks.

sources.quoted_phrase: Where possible, oil storage tanks should be installed in open air at ground level at least 6m from adjacent buildings
Storing LESS than 30kL per tank for diesel (above ground tank)

rows.label: Emergency generator set
rows.source_ref: SCDF Fire Code 2023 Cl.1.4.38, Table 6.4A
rows.source_note: Generator rooms are 2-hour compartments; the generator supplies the secondary power for life-safety systems.

sources.quoted_phrase: refers to emergency power-generating equipment that complies with the requirements stipulated in SS 535.

rows.label: Oil-filled transformer
rows.source_ref: SCDF Fire Code 2023 Cl.3.2.5j(2); IEC 60296 limits as restated in Journal of Energy (2021)
rows.source_note: 135 °C is the IEC 60296 minimum flash point for mineral transformer oil; actual oils are at or above it. Location must be ground level against an external wall.

sources.locator: Cl.3.2.5j(2) Areas of special high risk
sources.quoted_phrase: Room housing transformer that uses flammable liquid shall be located at ground level against an external wall.

sources.locator: HSE property table: flash point (ISO 2719), transformer oil min. 135 °C

rows.label: Lithium-ion battery room (UPS or ESS)
rows.source_ref: SCDF Fire Code 2023 Cl.10.3, Table 10.3.1
rows.source_note: ESS rules apply above 20 kWh and cap 600 kWh per compartment without SCDF approval. HF as the release agent is Assumed (UL 9540A / NFPA 855 not accessed).

sources.locator: Table 10.3.1, row 'Lithium-ion batteries, all types' (threshold 20 kWh, maximum 600 kWh per compartment)

sources.quoted_phrase: ESS units shall be subjected to the fire and explosion testing specified under UL 9540A.

rows.label: Lead-acid battery room
rows.source_ref: SCDF Fire Code 2023 Table 10.3.1, Cl.7.1.15
rows.source_note: Battery-room ventilation and hydrogen detectors keep hydrogen at or below 1% by volume (its LFL is 4%).

sources.locator: Table 10.3.1, row 'Lead-acid batteries, all types' (threshold 70 kWh, maximum 600 kWh)
Cl.7.1.15c Ventilation system for rooms housing batteries
sources.quoted_phrase: does not exceed 1% of the total volume of the room

rows.label: Electric-vehicle traction batteries
rows.source_ref: SCDF EMS, Fire and Enforcement Statistics 2025 para 27; Fire Code 2023 Cl.10.4.2
rows.source_note: EVs were 6.82% of vehicles at end 2025; 4 of 226 vehicle fires involved EVs. Charging bays need isolation switches within 15 m. HF agent Assumed.

sources.quoted_phrase: vehicle population in Singapore as at end 2025 comprised 93.18% of internal combustion engine vehicles and 6.82% of EVs
